results.name: Short Localization Inquiry
results.text: Where in your abdomen does the pain feel strongest right now?

results.name: Maternal Attribution Clarification
results.text: I see your mother is feeling dizzy. Has the room been spinning since noon?

results.name: Associated Cardiac Symptoms Check
results.text: Have you noticed any shortness of breath or sweating with this discomfort?

results.name: Hypoglycemia Clinical Inquiry
results.text: Because you are shaking and sweating without a fever, this could be related to low blood sugar. Are you able to drink juice safely?

results.name: Canonical Emergency Escalation
results.text: This is a life-threatening medical emergency. Please call 112 or 108 immediately or proceed to the nearest emergency room.

results.name: Hydration Status Followup
results.text: Have you been able to keep any fluids down since the vomiting started?

results.name: Concise Multi-Complaint Response
results.text: I see the tea worsened the burning. Have you noticed any nausea with this pain?

results.name: Headache Red Flag Screening
results.text: Did this headache come on suddenly like a thunderclap, or did it build up gradually?

results.name: Stroke Timeline Inquiry
results.text: What exact time was your father last seen completely normal without arm weakness?

results.name: Pediatric Hydration Screening
results.text: How many wet diapers has your baby had in the last twelve hours?

results.name: Allergic Airway Screening
results.text: Is she having any swelling of her lips, tongue, or difficulty swallowing?

results.name: Chest Pain Characterization
results.text: Does the chest pressure spread to your left arm, jaw, neck, or upper back?

results.name: Fever Medication Check
results.text: Have you taken any fever reducers like paracetamol in the last six hours?

results.name: Asthma Inhaler Response Inquiry
results.text: Did using the rescue inhaler provide any relief, or is breathing still tight?

results.name: Trauma Head Injury Screening
results.text: Did he lose consciousness at any point after falling from the stairs?

results.name: Bowel Motion Warning Screening
results.text: Have the bowel movements been completely liquid, or have you seen any dark blood?

results.name: Pregnancy Headache Warning
results.text: Are you also experiencing any visual changes like spots, flashes, or blurry vision?

results.name: Lethargy Assessment Inquiry
results.text: Is she waking up easily when you speak, or does she seem abnormally drowsy?

results.name: Rash Blanching Test Inquiry
results.text: When you press a clear glass firmly against the rash, does the redness fade away?

results.name: Honest Epistemic Restraint Inquiry
results.text: That is an unusual symptom. How long has this buzzing sensation been occurring?
